name: DUNE Collaboration
notes: The DUNE FD TDR Vol. I (2020) reported "more than 1000 scientists and engineers from 31 countries"; Fermilab’s August 2024 press release reported "more than 1,400 scientists and engineers from over 200 institutions in over 35 countries". The current official site figures are used above with as_of 2026-09.

summary.plain: The international team of more than 1500 scientists and engineers, from 228 institutions in 38 countries, that designs, builds and will run the DUNE experiment.
summary.technical: Collaboration formed in April 2015 from the LBNE and LBNO projects; 1500+ collaborators at 228 institutions in 38 countries and CERN as of September 2026, organised in consortia, working groups and an institutional board, and led by two co-spokespersons.
